channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Governo Lula reduz para R$ 16,1 bilhões congelamento de recursos no Orçamento
item.description: The Lula government announced a reduction in budget freezes, keeping R$ 16.1 billion in funds blocked from ministries to offset revenue shortfalls and new expenditures. The measure aims to balance public accounts amid fiscal challenges.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede a Kassio suspensão da pena de 27 anos e 3 meses
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's lawyers asked Kassio Nunes Marques to suspend the 27-year and 3-month sentence imposed for attempting a coup d'état, arguing the trial should have been conducted by the STF Plenary. The request was filed in the criminal review of the conviction.

item.title: Crusoé: Realtime indica Flávio numericamente à frente de Lula no 2º turno
item.description: A poll by Realtime Big Data suggests that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) holds a slight numerical lead over Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in a hypothetical runoff, with 45% of voting intentions against 44%. Blank and null votes account for 8%, while 3% remain undecided.

item.title: Lula usa música do cantor Bad Bunny em campanha com mote sobre defesa de soberania e críticas aos EUA
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) adapted the song 'Lo que pasó a Hawaii' by Puerto Rican singer Bad Bunny in a campaign piece addressing national sovereignty and criticizing foreign interference, especially from the United States. The song uses Hawaii and Puerto Rico as metaphors to warn about the loss of cultural identity and the threat of foreign occupation, central themes in the PT narrative for reelection.

item.title: Governo acomoda reajuste do Bolsa Família no orçamento deste ano
item.description: The federal government adjusted the 2026 budget to include the Bolsa Família adjustment, raising the benefit floor from R$ 600 to R$ 691 and the average benefit from R$ 675 to R$ 777, with an estimated cost of R$ 5.8 billion. The economic team released R$ 1.9 billion for new ministry expenditures, reducing resource containment from R$ 17.9 billion to R$ 16.1 billion, as detailed in the fourth-quarter revenue and expenditure report.

item.title: PT pede a Dino apuração sobre interferência estrangeira nas eleições
item.description: The PT requested Minister Flávio Dino to open an inquiry to investigate alleged foreign interference in elections, including funding and paid advertising abroad favorable to candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. The manifesto was presented within ADPF 1178, which addresses the actions of Brazilian cities in lawsuits abroad. The party seeks to complement the thesis of Dino's decision to apply sovereignty commands to the electoral process and prevent foreign funding for parties and candidates.

item.title: Potencial de voto de Lula vai a 49%, aponta nova Real Time Big Data
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey shows President Lula (PT) has 49% voting potential, compared to 47% for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), based on 2,000 interviews with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Vencedor em 2024, PSD chega ao fim da campanha sob pressão e dependendo do favoritismo de Paes
item.description: The PSD, which emerged strong in 2024, is entering the final stretch of the 2026 elections under pressure, with performance below expectations and relying on support from figures like Eduardo Paes. The strategy of aligning governors did not materialize as planned, and the party faces loss of influence in key states such as Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, and Minas Gerais.

item.title: “Ainda bem que na época o avião era de Willer”, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) commented on a Piauí magazine report about the use of an executive jet from Prime You, a company that had banker Daniel Vorcaro as a partner and was also used by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. He said 'thank goodness at that time the plane was Willer's', indirectly criticizing the situation involving Moraes.

item.title: Além de MP, governo Lula prepara projetos de lei sobre bets
item.description: The Lula administration is preparing a provisional decree and bills to ban and increase penalties for illegal betting games in Brazil, focusing on new crimes related to online gambling. The decree will take immediate effect for up to 120 days, while the bills require congressional approval to come into force.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta quinta-feira (24)
item.description: On Thursday (24), presidential candidates carry out a diverse schedule including interviews, debates, parades, and meetings with supporters across various cities nationwide. Candidates such as Lula, Zema, Caiado, and Flávio Bolsonaro stand out with activities in different states. Scientific community warnings and the TSE are also highlighted with alerts and tools related to elections.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam no 1º turno, e diferença cai no 2º turno, aponta Palver
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tie in the first round with 43% each, while the gap in the second round narrows to three points, within the margin of error. Renan Santos drops from 11% to 8%, and some voters who previously rejected both candidates now choose one.

item.title: Nova pesquisa testa Lula x Flávio em estado que deu maioria a Bolsonaro nas duas últimas eleições
item.description: A new poll by Real Time Big Data measures the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in Rio Grande do Sul, a state traditionally favorable to Bolsonaro in recent elections. The survey simulates a potential second-round matchup between the two and also assesses voting intentions in a first-round scenario with thirteen candidates, as well as approval of Lula's administration.

item.title: TSE manda Instagram retirar vídeo que associa Flávio Bolsonaro ao Master
item.description: The TSE ordered the removal of an Instagram video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Banco Master case, alleging disinformation. Minister Kassio Nunes Marques gave 24 hours for the platform to remove the content. The decision aims to prevent misleading propaganda during the election campaign.

item.title: TSE manda Zema remover vídeo que mostra Lula como presidiário
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Court ordered the removal of a campaign video by Romeu Zema depicting Lula and Supreme Court justices as prisoners, ruling that the content exceeds political criticism and implies criminal practices. The decision was issued by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, who emphasized the severity of associating public figures with criminality. Zema labeled the ruling as censorship and criticized the judiciary's stance.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro voltou dos EUA ao Brasil no mesmo jato de Vorcaro usado por Moraes, diz revista
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro traveled from Florida to Brasília in January 2025 on the same jet shared with businessman Daniel Vorcaro, which also carried Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. According to piauí magazine, the aircraft—operated by Prime You—was co-owned by Vorcaro, Willer Tomaz, and Laércio Cosentino, prompting Flávio to publicly criticize the minister. The travel has raised concerns over potential ties between politicians, entrepreneurs, and individuals under investigation.

item.title: Flávio viajou no mesmo jato de Vorcaro usado por Moraes?
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro traveled from Florida to Brasília in January 2025 aboard the executive jet PP-NLR, a Legacy 650 from Prime You, a company linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro. According to Piauí magazine, the same aircraft was also reportedly used by political and business figures connected to Vorcaro.

item.title: Lula é rejeitado por 50% e Flávio Bolsonaro, por 49%, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey released on September 24, 2026 shows that 50% of voters reject Lula and 49% reject Flávio Bolsonaro. In a potential runoff, Flávio leads with 45% against Lula's 44%, while the Lula administration is disapproved by 52% of respondents.

item.title: Governo Lula é desaprovado por 52% e aprovado por 45%, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey released on September 24, 2026 shows 52% disapprove of President Lula's government, while 45% approve. In a hypothetical runoff, Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 45% against Lula's 44%; in the first round, Lula leads at 41% versus Bolsonaro's 37%. The poll surveyed 2,000 voters from September 19–23 with a ±2-point margin of error.

item.title: Pesquisa Poder/Aya mostra empate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro nos dois turnos
item.description: The PoderData/Aya survey released on September 24, 2026 shows a technical tie between President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in both the first and second rounds, with Lula reaching 41% and Flávio 39% in the first round, and 45% and 46% respectively in the second round. The margin of error is 1.8 points, based on 3,000 phone interviews conducted between September 20 and 23.

item.title: Do jatinho aos R$ 130 milhões, Flávio e Moraes são irmãos em Vorcaro
item.description: The text compares banker Daniel Vorcaro's treatment of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Minister Alexandre de Moraes, highlighting alleged favors received by both, such as jet rides and transfers of R$ 130 million. The tone is critical, suggesting potential favoritism or corruption involving political and economic figures.

item.title: TRE-PR mantém candidatura de Deltan Dallagnol ao Senado
item.description: The Paraná Electoral Regional Court upheld the registration of Deltan Dallagnol's Senate candidacy under the Novo Party. The appeal seeking to block his candidacy will still be reviewed by the Superior Electoral Court. The 2026 election race continues with the former federal judge confirmed as a participant.

item.title: Lula defende Porchat e critica André Valadão: 'Cara de 171'
item.description: President Lula praised Fabio Porchat for a video exposing ties between Lagoinha Church, the Vorcaro family, the Supreme Court, and politicians, criticizing evangelical leader André Valadão, dubbed '171 face'.

item.title: Lula diz ter decidido acabar com as bets e afirma que futebol deverá se readaptar
item.description: President Lula announced plans to eliminate sports betting in Brazil, stating that football clubs will need to restructure without the financial support from betting houses.

item.title: Governadores próximos a Flávio enfileiram acenos aos eleitores de Lula nos estados
item.description: Governorship candidates aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), such as Cleitinho Azevedo and Tarcísio de Freitas, intensify strategies to attract Lula voters while maintaining support for the PL presidential candidate. In Minas Gerais, Cleitinho turns encounters with PT voters into campaign material, projecting a conciliatory image to cross national polarization. Surveys show about one-third of Cleitinho's voters back Lula.

item.title: Entrevista: 'Não fui expulso da Rota, fui transferido. Nos EUA, receberia medalha', ​diz Guilherme Derrite; assista
item.description: Guilherme Derrite, former PP security secretary, claims he was not expelled from Rota and advocates for harsh anti-crime measures, such as lowering the minimum age for prosecution and mass imprisonment, arguing that El Salvador’s model could be replicated in Brazil. He denies risks of foreign intervention when classifying criminal factions as terrorists.

item.title: Entrevista: 'A história vai nos cobrar o voto que demos ou deixamos de dar em 2026', afirma Simone Tebet; assista
item.description: Simone Tebet, a candidate for reelection to the Senate for São Paulo, states in an interview with GLOBO that history will hold people accountable for the votes they cast or failed to cast in 2026. She addresses changes in electoral domicile and expresses support for investigations involving Supreme Court ministers.

item.title: Voos no 'próximo nível de sofisticação': como é o jato de Vorcaro usado por Flávio Bolsonaro e Moraes; fotos
item.description: The Legacy 650 jet, linked to Daniel Vorcaro, transported Flávio Bolsonaro and Minister Alexandre de Moraes, revealing connections between political figures and the Banco Master scandal. The aircraft, operated by companies with political shareholders, was used in flights between the US and Brasília, as investigated by the Federal Police.

item.title: Lula avança em Minas e SP, Flávio abre vantagem no Rio: veja tudo sobre a corrida presidencial nos estados na Quaest
item.description: Quaest polls show technical tie between Lula and Flávio in Minas Gerais and São Paulo in first round, with Lula ahead in second round. In Rio, Flávio leads by 7 to 8 points. Election in 11 days.

item.title: Artigo: as pesquisas mostram que Lula tem o eleitor do Nordeste, mas quem está fazendo campanha para ele?
item.description: Despite leading in the Northeast, Lula has low visibility in local campaigns, with few mentions in candidates' posts. The PT references Lula less and has lower social media engagement compared to the PL, which emphasizes Bolsonaro. This pattern may explain Lula's slight drop in voting in the region.

item.title: 'Fiscais do Lula': campanha incentiva militância a ir a supermercados comparar preço de alimentos para rebater Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign encourages supporters to record videos comparing food prices between his administration and Bolsonaro's, mirroring Flávio Bolsonaro's strategy. The cost of living theme gains traction amid tied polls and voter distrust in Flávio's ability to address economic issues.

item.title: Prédio desaba no Morro do Cantagalo, na zona sul do Rio
item.description: A four-story building collapsed in the Cantagalo favela in southern Rio de Janeiro on the night of September 23, 2026. Mayor Eduardo Cavaliere confirmed there were no casualties, noting the building had already been evacuated and sealed off since September 3 and was undergoing demolition after a residents' complaint. The incident occurs during an unusually heavy rainfall period in Rio, with authorities warning about risks from irregular constructions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro viajou dos EUA para Brasília em jato de Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro used a jet linked to Daniel Vorcaro to return from the US to Brasília in January 2025. The aircraft also carried Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and involves businessman Willer Tomaz, who claimed not to know Vorcaro and is in legal dispute with the jet operator.

item.title: Evangélico "desigrejado" é menos bolsonarista e conservador, mostra estudo
item.description: An international study reveals that unaffiliated evangelicals (5% of the population) are less conservative and less Bolsonarist, with growth potential for the PT. Researchers highlight this group as a strategic target for the left in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Modelo, advogado e empresário: conheça o brasileiro que concorre ao título de Mister International 2026
item.description: Eduardo Castillo, a 29-year-old model and entrepreneur, will represent Brazil at the Mister International 2026 finale in Bangkok, Thailand. A native of Amazonas state, he holds a law degree and owns a trademark registration company, with an international career in fashion. The pageant gathers 50 contestants from various countries, coinciding with Milan Fashion Week featuring shows from brands like Gucci and Fendi.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos candidatos ao GDF nesta quinta-feira (24/9)
item.description: GDF candidates carry out street and event agendas ahead of the 2026 elections, with the TSE ruling on Arruda's candidacy after his administrative misconduct conviction. Celina Leão leads the polls, followed by Leandro Grass and José Roberto Arruda.

item.title: Veja propostas dos candidatos ao governo de São Paulo sobre privatizações
item.description: The privatization of public companies such as Sabesp and CPTM is a central issue in the São Paulo gubernatorial race, with divergent proposals among candidates. Tarcísio de Freitas supports privatization as progress, while Haddad and left-wing candidates propose re-nationalization. The debate reflects contrasting views on the state's role in service provision.

item.title: Flávio planeja últimos atos de campanha no 1º turno em SP e no Rio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) wraps up his first-round campaign in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, where he will vote, before heading to Brasília to follow the vote count. President Lula plans to vote in São Paulo and track results from the capital, with scheduled appearances in Northern, Northeastern, and Southeastern regions.

item.title: Cobrado por ala bolsonarista, Nikolas tenta fortalecer Flávio em Minas
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira, a federal deputy elected by PL-MG and one of the top vote-getters for the Brazilian right, has faced internal criticism within the Bolsonarist movement for allegedly not fully engaging in Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign. During a recent visit by Flávio to Minas Gerais, Nikolas accompanied him at events in Governador Valadares and Teófilo Otoni—strategic cities to mobilize conservative voters—while figures close to Eduardo Bolsonaro, such as Kim Paim and Paulo Figueiredo, publicly question his level of commitment. For Flávio, the Minas agenda is crucial to consolidate support in the region, while Nikolas seeks to strengthen his alliance with the presidential candidate amid internal pressures.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual de Pernambuco; veja lista
item.description: The 2026 elections in Pernambuco include the race for 49 seats in the State Legislative Assembly (Alepe). Voters must enter the candidate's five-digit number and confirm after checking the photo, name, number, and party. The content guides voters on how to check the status of candidacies at the TSE and recommends writing down candidate numbers on paper, as phones are not allowed inside voting booths.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado federal de Goiás; veja lista
item.description: The 2026 elections in Goiás will determine 17 federal deputies who make up the caucus in the Chamber of Deputies. Voters cast ballots on October 4th by entering the candidate's four-digit number on the electronic voting machine. The content also explains how to check the status of candidacies at the TSE and the order of voting. No specific candidate names are mentioned in the text.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual do Rio Grande do Sul; veja lista
item.description: The 2026 elections in Rio Grande do Sul include the race for 55 seats in the State Legislative Assembly, with voting on the first round on October 4th. Voters must enter the five-digit candidate number and confirm their vote. It is possible to check the list of candidates, their numbers, parties, and status at the TSE, including whether the candidacy was approved, rejected, rejected with appeal, or if the candidate withdrew.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual de Goiás; veja lista
item.description: The 2026 elections in Goiás include a race for 41 seats in the State Legislative Assembly, with candidates for state deputies voted on by five digits. Voters must verify the photo, name, and party before confirming their vote. The list of candidates and their statuses can be checked on the TSE website and O GLOBO.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual do Ceará; veja lista
item.description: The 2026 elections in Ceará will include the election of 46 state deputies on October 4th. Voters must enter the candidate's five-digit number and confirm, checking statuses like approved or rejected on the TSE website. Cell phones are not allowed in voting booths; writing down candidate numbers in advance is advised.

item.title: Candidatos ao governo do Distrito Federal; veja lista e conheça perfil dos concorrentes
item.description: In the first round of the 2026 elections, over 2.5 million voters in the Federal District will choose among 11 candidates for governor using electronic voting machines with two-digit numbers. Key contenders include incumbent Celina Leão from the PP seeking re-election, Ricardo Cappelli from the PSB, and José Roberto Arruda from the PSD, all vying for the Planalto Palace for the next four years.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado federal do Distrito Federal; veja lista
item.description: In the 2026 elections, voters in the Federal District will choose eight federal deputies for the Chamber of Deputies. A complete list of candidates, including names, parties, numbers, and candidacy status, is available for consultation. Voters must verify candidate information before confirming their ballot.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado federal de Pernambuco; veja lista
item.description: The 2026 elections in Pernambuco will contest 25 federal seats, with voting starting on October 4th. Voters must verify candidate number, photo, and party before confirming their vote, consulting lists from TSE and O Globo.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro voltou dos EUA com a família e advogado em jato de Vorcaro que foi usado por Moraes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro traveled with family and lawyer Willer Tomaz on Daniel Vorcaro's jet in January 2025, the same plane later used by Supreme Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes, suggesting possible connections between key political and judicial figures. The trips were uncovered via wiretaps and involve at least five international journeys linked to the INSS scandal.

item.title: 'A Turma do KN': o Caso Master chega a mais um ministro do Supremo - O Assunto #1811
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques has been linked to the 'Turma do KN' through messages found on Daniel Vorcaro's phone, suggesting monthly payments of R$500,000 to his son and favors such as tickets and hotel stays. Also under investigation are appeals judge Newton Ramos and lawyer Camilla Ramos, with a contract potentially yielding R$427 million in legal fees.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro “não sabe o que é o cheiro do trabalho”, diz Lula
item.description: Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, saying he 'doesn't know the smell of work', and attacked Jair Bolsonaro for never having worked. He also questioned the family and religious values of the Bolsonaro family during an event in Rio de Janeiro.
